title: Crockpot Marry Me Meatballs

ingredients.item: each onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika

steps: Load. Put the frozen meatballs and Alfredo sauce in the crockpot; add pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika and red pepper flakes.
Stir in. Add sun-dried tomatoes, Parmesan and milk; stir well.
Cook. Cook on low for 4 hours, stirring now and then. Top with more Parmesan and dried parsley.
Serve. Over mashed potatoes, rice or pasta. If the sauce separates, stir in a splash of milk.
notes: Recipe fetched from the creator's linked page: cookinginthemidwest.com/blog/crockpot-marry-me-meatballs
